rows.basis: AI-optimized servers net revenue of $24,683m from the fiscal 2026 10-K MD&A ISG table, up 166%, divided by total revenue of $113,538m. It excludes traditional servers and networking ($19,512m) and storage ($16,631m). The $64bn of orders and $43bn of backlog in the release are not revenue and are not counted.

Infrastructure Solutions Group revenue, the data-center line. It includes traditional servers, networking and storage, so it greatly overstates AI. The FY2026 10-K table gives AI-optimized servers at $9,286m for FY2025, but that figure is not a stated amount in the pack. Quarterly AI statements are demand or shipment figures, not full-year revenue.

Infrastructure Solutions Group revenue, the data-center line, which the MD&A says benefited from AI-optimized demand. It is mostly non-AI servers and storage. The FY2026 10-K table gives AI-optimized servers at only $1,873m for FY2024, which is not a stated amount in the pack.

Latest full-year AI-optimized servers revenue guidance of $74bn, from the Q2 FY27 release. It was raised from $50bn (Q4 FY26) and $60bn (Q1 FY27). Recognized so far is $16.1bn in Q1 and $16.4bn in Q2. Total FY2027 revenue guidance is $192bn, but that figure is not a pack value, so the share is null.
